---
title: "Figure 3: Disease-associated protein fractionation models"
output: html_document
---

## Purpose

Protein-level input preparation, model eligibility, variance decomposition, disease-by-fraction interaction models, robust-hit selection, example profiles and GO:CC enrichment for Figure 3A–E. The code for Figure 3F–H can be found in in `Resilience_modelling_final.Rmd`.

## Access and execution

This code is for inspection. Restricted participant-level inputs and intermediate objects are not included. Access to the restricted  ROSMAP clinical and neuropathological data is subject to the applicable data-use agreements, and can be requested through https://www.radc.rush.edu/ and https://www.synapse.org/

## Inputs

- `MAI_prot_model_new.rds`: Protein-level data - QC SummarizedExperiment with `log2Quant` and `MAI_imputed`.
- `demogs.xlsx`: Subject-level data - restricted subject covariates (`Subject`, `pmi`, `msex`, `age_death`, `gpath`, `Group`).

```{r display-settings, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(eval = FALSE)
```

## Prepare imputed and unimputed protein inputs

```{r prepare-protein-inputs}
library(SummarizedExperiment)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)
library(purrr)
library(readxl)
library(readr)
library(stringr)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Load SE containing both assays
# ------------------------------------------------------------
se_log2 <- readRDS("MAI_prot_model_new.rds")
assayNames(se_log2)
#"log2Quant", "MAI_imputed" (unimputed and imputed log-scaled intensity matrices)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Pull row/column metadata
# ------------------------------------------------------------
row_meta <- rowData(se_log2) %>% as.data.frame() %>% rownames_to_column("feature_id")
col_meta <- colData(se_log2) %>% as.data.frame() %>% dplyr::select(Plate, Well, Subject, Fraction) %>% rownames_to_column("RunID")

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. extract assay and pivot to long format
# ------------------------------------------------------------
extract_assay_long <- function(se, assay_name, assay_type_label) {
  assay(se, assay_name) %>%
    as.data.frame() %>% rownames_to_column("feature_id") %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = -feature_id, names_to = "RunID", values_to = "log2_value") %>%
    mutate(assay_name = assay_name,
           assay_type = assay_type_label)
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. concatenate imputed and unimputed together for easy indexing in model function
# ------------------------------------------------------------
long_assays <- bind_rows(
  extract_assay_long(se_log2, "log2Quant", "unimputed"),
  extract_assay_long(se_log2, "MAI_imputed", "imputed")) %>%
  #obtain the raw intensity value from the log2 scaled values
  mutate(value = 2^log2_value) %>%
  #join with the row and column metadata
  left_join(row_meta, by = "feature_id") %>%
  left_join(col_meta, by = "RunID") 

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. # Join with demographic data and markers
# ------------------------------------------------------------
demogs <- read_excel(input_file("demogs.xlsx")) %>% 
  dplyr::select(Subject, pmi, msex, age_death, gpath, Group)

long_assays <- long_assays %>% left_join(demogs, by = "Subject")

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. #Flag and fix ambiguous gene names across both assays (multi-protein Genes)
# ------------------------------------------------------------
long_assays <- long_assays %>%
  group_by(Genes) %>%
  mutate(multi_pg_flag = n_distinct(Protein.Group) > 1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(Genes = if_else(multi_pg_flag,
      paste0(Genes, "_", Protein.Group), Genes))

long_assays %>% filter(multi_pg_flag == TRUE) %>% dplyr::select(Genes, Protein.Group) %>% distinct() #check
long_assays %>% dplyr::select(Genes, Protein.Group) %>% distinct()

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. #sum-normalise both assays separately
# ------------------------------------------------------------
prop_long <- long_assays %>%
  mutate(Fraction = factor(Fraction, levels = as.character(1:7)),
         Group = factor(Group, levels = c("CON", "RES", "AD-DEM"))) %>%
  group_by(assay_type, Subject, feature_id) %>%
  mutate(sum = sum(value, na.rm = TRUE),
         prop = value / sum) %>% ungroup()
```


## Define the eligible protein set

- Based on threshsolds: <70% missingness, total intensity >500 for every subject, and >= 4 observations per disease-group fraction.
- Count: 4794 - to be used as background set for enrichment analysis

```{r model-universe}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. #define model Gene universe (function): 
# ------------------------------------------------------------
filter_model_genes <- function(
    df,
    assay = "unimputed",
    feature_var = "Genes",
    group_var = "Group",
    subject_var = "Subject",
    fraction_var = "Fraction",
    raw_var = "value",
    quant_var = "log2_value",
    groups_to_keep = c("CON", "RES", "AD-DEM"),
    max_global_missing = 0.70,
    min_subject_sum = 500,
    min_nonmissing_per_cell = 5) {
  
  df0 <- df %>%
    filter(assay_type == assay, .data[[group_var]] %in% groups_to_keep) %>%
    mutate(
      !!group_var := factor(.data[[group_var]], levels = groups_to_keep),
      !!fraction_var := factor(.data[[fraction_var]], levels = as.character(1:7)))
  
  crit_a <- df0 %>%
    group_by(.data[[feature_var]]) %>%
    summarise(prop_missing = mean(is.na(.data[[quant_var]])), .groups = "drop") %>%
    filter(prop_missing < max_global_missing)
  
  crit_b <- df0 %>%
    group_by(.data[[feature_var]], .data[[subject_var]]) %>%
    summarise(total_raw = sum(.data[[raw_var]], na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    group_by(.data[[feature_var]]) %>%
    summarise(pass_subject_sum = all(total_raw > min_subject_sum), .groups = "drop") %>%
    filter(pass_subject_sum)
  
  crit_c <- df0 %>%
    group_by(.data[[feature_var]], .data[[group_var]], .data[[fraction_var]]) %>%
    summarise(n_nonmissing = sum(!is.na(.data[[quant_var]])), .groups = "drop") %>%
    group_by(.data[[feature_var]]) %>%
    summarise(
      min_cell_n = min(n_nonmissing),
      pass_cell_n = all(n_nonmissing >= min_nonmissing_per_cell),
      .groups = "drop") %>%
    filter(pass_cell_n)
  
  gene_table <- crit_a %>%
    inner_join(crit_b, by = feature_var) %>%
    inner_join(crit_c, by = feature_var) %>%
    dplyr::select(all_of(feature_var), prop_missing, min_cell_n)
  
  list(gene_list = gene_table[[feature_var]],
      gene_table = gene_table,
      n_genes = nrow(gene_table))
}

#### FILTER #####
gene_filter <- filter_model_genes(
  df = prop_long,
  assay = "unimputed",
  feature_var = "Genes",
  group_var = "Group",
  subject_var = "Subject",
  fraction_var = "Fraction",
  raw_var = "value",
  quant_var = "log2_value",
  groups_to_keep = c("CON", "RES", "AD-DEM"),
  max_global_missing = 0.70,
  min_subject_sum = 500,
  min_nonmissing_per_cell = 4)

model_gene_list <- gene_filter$gene_list
length(model_gene_list) #4794
#write_csv(gene_filter$gene_table, output_file("backgroundset_4794.csv"))
```


## Figure 3A: Variance decomposition

Compares the relative importance of predictors for each protein (quantifies decrease in marginal R2 when each predictor is removed from the full model). Negative differences are set to zero, and each decrease is expressed as a proportion of their sum.

```{r variance-models}
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(lme4)
library(performance)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1) Prepare data
# ------------------------------------------------------------
varpart_input <- prop_long %>%
  filter(assay_type == "imputed") %>%
  dplyr::select(Genes, log2_value, Group, Fraction, age_death, msex, pmi, Subject) %>%
  filter(Group %in% c("AD-DEM", "CON", "RES"), Genes %in% model_gene_list) %>%
  mutate(Condition   = factor(Group),
    Fraction    = factor(Fraction),
    msex        = factor(msex),
    Subject     = factor(Subject),
    age_death_z = as.numeric(scale(age_death)),
    pmi_z       = as.numeric(scale(pmi)))


#Store results
res_list <- vector("list", length(unique(varpart_input$Genes)))
names(res_list) <- unique(varpart_input$Genes)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2) Loop through genes
# ------------------------------------------------------------
for (g in unique(varpart_input$Genes)) {
  
  cat("Running:", g, "\n")
  control <- lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa", optCtrl = list(maxfun = 2e5))
  
  df_gene <- varpart_input %>% filter(Genes == g)
  
  # full model
  full_mod <- lmer(
    log2_value ~ Condition + Fraction + age_death_z + msex + pmi_z + (1 | Subject),
    data = df_gene, REML = FALSE,
    control = control)
  
  full_r2 <- r2_nakagawa(full_mod)$R2_marginal
  
  # reduced models
  mod_condition <- lmer(
    log2_value ~ Fraction + age_death_z + msex + pmi_z + (1 | Subject),
    data = df_gene, REML = FALSE,
    control = control)
  
  mod_fraction <- lmer(
    log2_value ~ Condition + age_death_z + msex + pmi_z + (1 | Subject),
    data = df_gene, REML = FALSE, control = control)
  
  mod_age <- lmer(
    log2_value ~ Condition + Fraction + msex + pmi_z + (1 | Subject),
    data = df_gene, REML = FALSE, control = control)
  
  mod_sex <- lmer(
    log2_value ~ Condition + Fraction + age_death_z + pmi_z + (1 | Subject),
    data = df_gene, REML = FALSE,  control = control)
  
  mod_pmi <- lmer(
    log2_value ~ Condition + Fraction + age_death_z + msex + (1 | Subject),
    data = df_gene, REML = FALSE, control = control)
  
  # reduced model R2
  r2_condition <- r2_nakagawa(mod_condition)$R2_marginal
  r2_fraction  <- r2_nakagawa(mod_fraction)$R2_marginal
  r2_age       <- r2_nakagawa(mod_age)$R2_marginal
  r2_sex       <- r2_nakagawa(mod_sex)$R2_marginal
  r2_pmi       <- r2_nakagawa(mod_pmi)$R2_marginal
  
  #delta R2
  out <- tibble(
    Genes = g, term = c("Condition", "Fraction", "age_death", "msex", "pmi"),
    delta_r2 = c(
      full_r2 - r2_condition,
      full_r2 - r2_fraction,
      full_r2 - r2_age,
      full_r2 - r2_sex,
      full_r2 - r2_pmi)) %>%
    mutate(delta_r2 = pmax(delta_r2, 0), pct = delta_r2 / sum(delta_r2) * 100)
  
  res_list[[g]] <- out
}

#bind together
varpart_perc <- bind_rows(res_list)
varpart_perc
```


## Figure 3A: Plot relative variance contributions

```{r variance-plot}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1) Transform variance
# ------------------------------------------------------------
varpart_perc <- varpart_perc %>% mutate(log_pct = log(1+pct), sqrt_pct = sqrt(pct))  #scaled var for visualisation

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2) Order terms
# ------------------------------------------------------------
term_order <- varpart_perc %>%
  group_by(term) %>%
  summarise(mean_pct = mean(pct, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(mean_pct)) %>%
  pull(term)

varpart_perc$term <- factor(varpart_perc$term, levels = term_order)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3) Top labels
# ------------------------------------------------------------
top10_proteins <- varpart_perc %>%
  group_by(term) %>% filter(term == "Condition") %>%
  slice_max(order_by = pct, n = 10, with_ties = FALSE)

top10_labels <- top10_proteins %>%
  group_by(term) %>%
  arrange(desc(sqrt_pct), .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    ymax = max(sqrt_pct),

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 4) Palette

  show.legend = FALSE) +
  
  scale_fill_manual(values = my_pal) +

  labs(x = NULL,  y = "√(variance explained %)") +
  theme_classic(base_family = "Helvetica", base_size = 10) +
theme(
  legend.position = "none",
  plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10),
  plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10),
  axis.title = element_text(size = 10),
  axis.text = element_text(size = 10),
  axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10),
  legend.title = element_text(size = 10),
  legend.text = element_text(size = 10))

fixed
```

## Disease-by-fraction model function

```{r disease-model-function}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 8. #write model function 
# ------------------------------------------------------------
library(lme4)
library(dplyr)
library(performance)
library(tibble)

#pass arguments to function
fit_fraction_interaction_models <- function(
    gene_list, dataframe,
    assay_to_use = c("imputed", "unimputed"),
    dataset_label = NULL,
    feature_var = "Genes",
    response_var = "log2_value",
    group_var = "Group",
    fraction_var = "Fraction",
    subject_var = "Subject",
    sex_var = "msex",
    continuous_vars = c("age_death", "pmi"),
    group_levels = c("CON", "RES", "AD-DEM"),
    ref_group = "CON",
    fraction_levels = as.character(1:7),
    scale_continuous = TRUE,
    include_covariate_fraction_interactions = TRUE,
    min_rows = 10, fdr_method = "BH"
) {
  
  assay_to_use <- match.arg(assay_to_use)
  if (is.null(dataset_label)) dataset_label <- assay_to_use
  
  df0 <- dataframe %>%
    filter(assay_type == assay_to_use, .data[[group_var]] %in% group_levels ) %>% #filter conditions
    mutate(!!group_var := factor(.data[[group_var]], levels = group_levels), #set categ vars
      !!group_var := relevel(.data[[group_var]], ref = ref_group),
      !!fraction_var := factor(.data[[fraction_var]], levels = fraction_levels),
      !!subject_var := factor(.data[[subject_var]]),
      !!sex_var := factor(.data[[sex_var]]))
  
  if (scale_continuous) { #scale continuous variables, pmi and age_death
    z_names <- paste0(continuous_vars, "_z")
    for (i in seq_along(continuous_vars)) {
      v <- continuous_vars[i]
      vz <- z_names[i]
      df0[[vz]] <- as.numeric(scale(df0[[v]]))
    }
    cont_terms <- z_names
  } else {
    cont_terms <- continuous_vars
  }
  
  main_cov_terms <- c(cont_terms, sex_var)
  
  ## this tells the model to fit interaxtions with pmi, age_death and sex 
  if (include_covariate_fraction_interactions) {
    frac_cov_terms <- c(paste0(cont_terms, ":", fraction_var), paste0(sex_var, ":", fraction_var) )
  } else {
    frac_cov_terms <- character(0)
  }
  
  ## define predictor terms for full and reduced model
  reduced_terms <- c(group_var, fraction_var, main_cov_terms, frac_cov_terms)
  full_terms    <- c(reduced_terms, paste0(group_var, ":", fraction_var))
  
  ## define both formulas (full and reduced)
  reduced_formula <- as.formula(paste(response_var, "~", paste(reduced_terms, collapse = " + "), "+ (1 |", subject_var, ")"))
  full_formula <- as.formula(paste(response_var, "~", paste(full_terms, collapse = " + "),  "+ (1 |", subject_var, ")"))
  
  #Store results in a list
  results <- vector("list", length(gene_list))
  names(results) <- gene_list
  
  for (gene in gene_list) { #iterate through gene universe
    dat_g <- df0 %>%
      filter(.data[[feature_var]] == gene) %>%
      filter( #ensure categorical variables are present for this gene
        !is.na(.data[[response_var]]),
        !is.na(.data[[group_var]]),
        !is.na(.data[[fraction_var]]),
        !is.na(.data[[subject_var]]),
        !is.na(.data[[sex_var]]))
    
    for (v in cont_terms) { #ensure continuous variables are present for this gene
      dat_g <- dat_g %>% filter(!is.na(.data[[v]]))
    }
    
    ##minumum levels required (skip if missing)
    if (nrow(dat_g) < min_rows ||
        nlevels(dat_g[[group_var]]) < 2 || #can be no less than 2 disease groups
        nlevels(dat_g[[fraction_var]]) < 2) next #can be no less than 2 fractions present
    
    #Try both models
    model_noint <- try(lmer(reduced_formula, data = dat_g, REML = FALSE), silent = TRUE)
    model_full <- try(lmer(full_formula, data = dat_g, REML = FALSE), silent = TRUE)
    
    #skip test if error occurs
    if (inherits(model_noint, "try-error") || inherits(model_full, "try-error")) next
    if (any(is.na(fixef(model_full)))) next
    
    #perform anova, skip if error occurs
    an <- try(anova(model_noint, model_full), silent = TRUE)
    if (inherits(an, "try-error")) next
    
    #store p value and chi-squared from anova
    pval <- an$`Pr(>Chisq)`[2]
    chisq <- an$Chisq[2]
    if (is.na(pval)) next
    #store marginal r2 explained by the Condition:Fraction interaction ('fractionation shift by disease' size effect)
    r2_noint <- suppressWarnings(r2_nakagawa(model_noint)$R2_marginal)
    r2_full  <- suppressWarnings(r2_nakagawa(model_full)$R2_marginal)
    
    ## store all results in a table
    results[[gene]] <- tibble(
      Genes = gene,
      dataset = dataset_label,
      groups_tested = paste(group_levels, collapse = "_"),
      reference_group = ref_group,
      n_obs = nrow(dat_g),
      n_subjects = n_distinct(dat_g[[subject_var]]),
      chi_sq = chisq,
      p_value = pval,
      delta_margin_r2 = r2_full - r2_noint,
      singular_reduced = isSingular(model_noint, tol = 1e-4),
      singular_full = isSingular(model_full, tol = 1e-4))
  }
  
  #all genes tested, adjusted for 4794 tests (checked this)
  out <- bind_rows(results) %>%
    mutate(padj = p.adjust(p_value, method = fdr_method)) %>%
    arrange(padj, p_value)
  
  list(full_list_mixmod = out, significant_mixmod = out %>% filter(padj < 0.05))
}
```


## Fit both assays and identify robust results

Robust hits are the intersection of significant imputed and unimputed results. 
Count: 217  results robus to imputation strategy

```{r fit-disease-models}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 8. #run both analyses in parallel
# ------------------------------------------------------------
res_unimp <- fit_fraction_interaction_models( 
  gene_list = model_gene_list,
  dataframe = prop_long,
  assay_to_use = "unimputed",
  dataset_label = "unimputed",
  group_levels = c("CON", "RES", "AD-DEM"),
  ref_group = "CON",
  scale_continuous = TRUE)

res_unimp$significant_mixmod %>% arrange(desc(delta_margin_r2))

res_imp <- fit_fraction_interaction_models(
  gene_list = model_gene_list,
  dataframe = prop_long,
  assay_to_use = "imputed",
  dataset_label = "imputed",
  group_levels = c("CON", "RES", "AD-DEM"),
  ref_group = "CON",
  scale_continuous = TRUE)

## identify robust results
stable_genes <- intersect(res_imp$significant_mixmod$Genes, res_unimp$significant_mixmod$Genes)
stable_results <- res_unimp$significant_mixmod %>% filter(Genes %in% stable_genes) %>% arrange(p_value)

gene_pg_map <- prop_long %>% dplyr::select(Protein.Group, First.Protein.Description, Genes) %>% distinct()
stable_results <- stable_results %>% arrange(desc(delta_margin_r2)) %>% left_join(gene_pg_map, by = "Genes")

## store results
#write_csv(stable_results, "stable_217_CON_AD_RES.csv")
#write_csv(res_unimp$full_list_mixmod, "unimp_results_CON_AD_RES.csv")
#write_csv(res_imp$full_list_mixmod, "imp_results_CON_AD_RES.csv")
```


## Figure 3C: Disease-model results


```{r disease-volcano}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(ggrepel)
library(paletteer)
library(scales)

df <- as_tibble(res_unimp$full_list_mixmod) %>% mutate(log10pval = -log10(p_value))

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Select top labels
# ------------------------------------------------------------
top_pval <- df %>% filter(padj < 0.05) %>% slice_max(order_by = log10pval, n = 50)
top_r2 <- df %>% filter(padj < 0.05) %>% slice_max(order_by = abs(delta_margin_r2), n = 50)

top_labels <- bind_rows(top_pval, top_r2) %>% distinct(Genes, .keep_all = TRUE)

# split labels by robust vs not robust
top_labels_stable <- top_labels %>%  filter(Genes %in% stable_results$Genes)
top_labels_nonstable <- top_labels %>% filter(!(Genes %in% stable_results$Genes))

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Volcano plot
# ------------------------------------------------------------
plot_unimp <- ggplot(df, aes(x = delta_margin_r2, y = log10pval, color = padj)) +

  # non-significant background
  geom_point(
    data = filter(df, padj >= 0.05),
    color = "grey85",
    size = 1.5,
    alpha = 0.5) +

  # significant points
  geom_point(
    data = filter(df, padj < 0.05),
    size = 1.8) +

  # robust labels
  geom_label_repel(
  data = top_labels_stable,
  aes(label = Genes, color = padj),
  size = 3,
  fontface = "bold",
  max.overlaps = 30,
  max.iter = 20000,
  box.padding = 0.3,
  label.padding = 0.15,
  label.r = 0.15,
  label.size = 0,
  fill = alpha("white", 0.9)) +

  # colour scale
  scale_color_paletteer_c(
    "ggthemes::Red-Gold",
    direction = -1,
    name = "FDR (padj)") +

  #labels
  labs(
    x = expression(Delta*" marginal R"^2),
    y = expression(-log[10](p-value))) +

  #consistent 10 pt Helvetica theme
  theme_classic(
    base_size = 10,
    base_family = "Helvetica") +

  theme(
    axis.text = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "right")

plot_unimp
```


## Figure 3B: APP, NPTX2 and SMOC1 profiles

```{r abundance-and-proportional-profiles}
condition_palette <- c("CON" = "royalblue1", "RES" = "yellowgreen", "AD-DEM" = "indianred2")
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)

selection <- c("APP", "NPTX2", "SMOC1") # Figure 3B manuscript exemplars.

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1) Log2-intensity summary
# ------------------------------------------------------------
ribbon_plots_log <- prop_long %>%
  filter(Genes %in% selection, assay_type == "imputed") %>%
  mutate(
    Fraction = factor(Fraction),
    log2Quant = log2(value)) %>%
  group_by(Group, Fraction, Genes) %>%
  summarise(
    n = sum(!is.na(log2Quant)),
    mean_log2 = mean(log2Quant, na.rm = TRUE),
    sdev = sd(log2Quant, na.rm = TRUE),
    sem = sdev / sqrt(n),
    .groups = "drop")

logscale_plot <- ggplot(
  ribbon_plots_log,
  aes(x = as.numeric(Fraction), y = mean_log2,
      color = Group, group = Group, fill = Group)) +
  geom_ribbon(
    aes(ymin = mean_log2 - sem, ymax = mean_log2 + sem),
    alpha = 0.4, color = NA) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 1, alpha = 0.9) +
  facet_wrap(~Genes, ncol = length(unique(ribbon_plots_log$Genes)), scales = "fixed") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:7) +
  scale_color_manual(values = condition_palette) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = condition_palette) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Mean log\u2082(intensity) ± SEM") +
  theme_classic(base_family = "Helvetica", base_size = 10) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "grey", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.8),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 10))

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2) Proportional abundance summary
# ------------------------------------------------------------
ribbon_plots_prop <- prop_long %>%
  filter(Genes %in% selection, assay_type == "imputed") %>%
  mutate(Fraction = factor(Fraction)) %>%
  group_by(Group, Fraction, Genes) %>%
  summarise(
    n = sum(!is.na(prop)),
    mean_prop = mean(prop, na.rm = TRUE),
    sdev = sd(prop, na.rm = TRUE),
    sem = sdev / sqrt(n),
    .groups = "drop")

propscale_plot <- ggplot(
  ribbon_plots_prop,
  aes(x = as.numeric(Fraction), y = mean_prop,
      color = Group, group = Group, fill = Group)) +
  geom_ribbon(
    aes(ymin = mean_prop - sem, ymax = mean_prop + sem),
    alpha = 0.4, color = NA) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 1, alpha = 0.9) +
  facet_wrap(~Genes, ncol = length(unique(ribbon_plots_log$Genes)), scales = "fixed") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:7) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::number_format(accuracy = 0.1)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = condition_palette) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = condition_palette) +
  labs(x = "Fraction", y = "Mean proportion ± SEM") +
  theme_classic(base_family = "Helvetica", base_size = 10) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "grey", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.8),
    strip.text = element_blank(),
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 10))

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3) Patchwork: log2 above, proportion below
# ------------------------------------------------------------
log_prop_plot <- logscale_plot / propscale_plot +
  plot_layout(heights = c(1, 1))

log_prop_plot
```

## Figure 3E: GO cellular-component enrichment

```{r disease-go-enrichment}
#pulling out protein groups for mapping
gene_pg_map <- prop_long %>% dplyr::select(Genes, Protein.Group) %>% distinct()

#read in full contrasts file (ad vs con vs res)
modelres <- as_tibble(res_unimp$full_list_mixmod) %>% 
  left_join(gene_pg_map, by = "Genes")
imp <- as_tibble(res_imp$full_list_mixmod) %>% filter(padj <0.05) %>% left_join(gene_pg_map, by = "Genes")

library(clusterProfiler)
library(org.Hs.eg.db)
library(dplyr)

# significant genes per contrast
sig_list <- modelres %>% filter(padj < 0.05, Protein.Group %in% imp$Protein.Group) %>%
  group_by(groups_tested) %>%
  summarise(entry = list(unique(Protein.Group)), .groups = "drop")

# background (all tested genes)
bg_genes <- unique(modelres$Protein.Group)
length(bg_genes)

#Convert to Entrez
all_genes <- unique(c(bg_genes,
  unlist(sig_list$entry)))

gene_map <- bitr(
  all_genes, fromType = "UNIPROT",   toType   = "ENTREZID",
  OrgDb    = org.Hs.eg.db)

bg_entrez <- gene_map %>%
  filter(UNIPROT %in% bg_genes) %>% pull(ENTREZID) %>% unique()

sig_list <- sig_list %>%
  mutate(entrez = lapply(entry, function(g) {
    gene_map %>% filter(UNIPROT %in% g) %>%
      pull(ENTREZID) %>%
      unique()
  }))

## here I want to split by groups_tested, run enrichment analysis on each unique comparison tested
ego_list <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(sig_list)), function(i) {
  
  contrast_name <- sig_list$groups_tested[i]
  gene_set <- sig_list$entrez[[i]]
  
  # skip small sets
  if (length(gene_set) < 20) return(NULL)
  
  ego <- enrichGO(
    gene          = gene_set,
    universe      = bg_entrez,
    OrgDb         = org.Hs.eg.db,
    keyType       = "ENTREZID",        #Uniprot IDs
    ont           = "CC",
    pAdjustMethod = "BH",   #within-test correction
    qvalueCutoff  = 0.5,
    readable      = TRUE)
  
  if (is.null(ego) || nrow(as.data.frame(ego)) == 0) return(NULL)
  
  df <- as.data.frame(ego)
  df$contrast <- contrast_name
  df
})

ego_df <- bind_rows(ego_list) %>%
  mutate(Strength = log10(FoldEnrichment)) %>%
  arrange(desc(Strength)) %>%
  distinct(geneID, .keep_all = TRUE)
```


## Figure 3E: GO themes and significance annotations

```{r go-themes}
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(ggplot2)

# ---- 1) Clean + assign themes ----
top_terms <- ego_df %>%
  #filter(Count > 7) %>%
  mutate(
    theme = case_when(
      str_detect(Description, regex("snRNP|splice|methylosome", TRUE)) ~ "RNA splicing",
      str_detect(Description, regex("AP-|coat|endosome|retromer|vesicle", TRUE)) ~ "Vesicle trafficking",
      str_detect(Description, regex("axon|projection|presynapse|growth cone", TRUE)) ~ "Neuronal compartment",
      str_detect(Description, regex("microtubule|dynactin", TRUE)) ~ "Cytoskeleton",
      str_detect(Description, regex("cytoplas", TRUE)) ~ "Cytoplasm",
      TRUE ~ "Other"),
    term = Description)

# ---- 2) Order terms within theme ----
top_terms <- top_terms %>%
  arrange(theme, desc(Strength)) %>%
  group_by(theme) %>%
  mutate(term = factor(term, levels = unique(term))) %>%
  ungroup()

# ---- 3) Set theme order (important for consistent layout) ----
top_terms$theme <- factor(top_terms$theme, levels = c(
  "RNA splicing",
  "Vesicle trafficking",
  "Neuronal compartment",
  "Cytoskeleton",
  "Cytoplasm",
  "Other"))

# ---- 4) Custom colour palette ----
theme_cols <- c(
  "RNA splicing" = "#2C7FB8",
  "Vesicle trafficking" = "#C77CFF",
  "Neuronal compartment" = "#1B9E77",
  "Cytoskeleton" = "#D95F02",
  "Cytoplasm" = "#E7298A",
  "Other" = "darkcyan")

ego_df <- ego_df %>%
  mutate(sig = case_when(
    p.adjust < 0.001 ~ "***",
    p.adjust < 0.01  ~ "**",
    p.adjust < 0.05  ~ "*",
    TRUE ~ ""
  ))

ego_df %>% dplyr::select(Description, sig)
unique_genes <- ego_df$geneID %>%
  str_split("/") %>%
  unlist() %>%
  unique()

#write_csv(ego_df, "GOCC_217_CON_AD_RES.csv")
```
